paper.title: Active Human Feedback Collection via Neural Contextual Dueling Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Active contextual dueling bandit with non-linear (neural) latent reward under BTL preferences
unmapped: The learner actively selects the context c_t from a context set at each round (active learning), then two arms
Objective is the worst sub-optimality gap over all contexts of the policy returned after T rounds: max_c [max_a f(phi(c,a)) - f(phi(c,pi(c)))]
Finite arm set; reward is f(phi(c,a)) for a known feature map phi and unknown bounded non-linear f, estimated by a wide ReLU network (NTK regime)
BTL / logistic link with kappa_mu = inf derivative > 0 and Lipschitz constant L_mu (Assumption 1)
settings.definition_quote: In each iteration, the learner selects a context $c_t \in \cX$ and then two arms ... receives a stochastic preference feedback $y_t$ ... $\Prob{y_t = 1| c_t, a_{t,1}, a_{t,2}} = \mu( f(\phi(c_t,a_{t,1})) - f(\phi(c_t,a_{t,2})))$ ... $\Delta_{\cD_T}^{\pi} = \max_{c \in \cC}[\max_{a \in \cA} f(\phi(c,a)) - f(\phi(c,\pi(c)))]$

conditions: Assumption 1: kappa_mu > 0, link continuously differentiable and L_mu-Lipschitz
conditions of Theorem thm:normUB: ||z_s|| <= L, ||V_s - V_{s-1}||^2 <= C_s, E[z_s z_s^T] <= Sigma_max
network width w >= poly(T, L, K, 1/kappa_mu, L_mu, 1/lambda_0, 1/lambda, log(1/delta))
tuning: nu_T = (beta_T + B sqrt(lambda/kappa_mu) + 1) sqrt(kappa_mu/lambda), beta_T = (1/kappa_mu) sqrt(d_eff + 2 log(1/delta))

source.label: thm:subGapUCB
source.quote: Let the conditions in \cref{thm:normUB} and \cref{lem:confBounds} hold. Then, with a probability with at least $1-\delta$, the worst sub-optimality gap of \algo{} when using UCB-based arm selection strategy is upper bounded by $\Delta_T^\pi \le ( \frac{\nu_TL}{G_T} )\sqrt{\frac{\lambda}{\kappa_\mu w}} + 2\varepsilon'_{w,T} = \tilde{O} ( \sqrt{\frac{\tilde{d}}{T}})$.

results.notes: Quantity is the worst-over-contexts sub-optimality gap of the returned policy (mapped to simple_regret). Explicit form uses G_T = sqrt(T lambda_min(Sigma_max) - sqrt(8 sum C_s log(d/delta))) and eps'_{w,T} = C_2 w^{-1/6} sqrt(log w) L^3 (T/lambda)^{4/3}; the O_tilde hides these, lambda_min(Sigma_max) and NN-width terms. The derivation of the O_tilde rate implicitly assumes lambda_min(Sigma_max) is constant and that G_T is well defined.

source.label: thm:subGapTS
source.quote: Let the conditions in \cref{thm:normUB} and \cref{lem:confBounds} hold. Then, with a probability with at least $1-\delta$, the worst sub-optimality gap of \algo{} when using TS-based arm selection strategy is upper bounded by $\Delta_T^\pi \le ( \frac{\nu_TL\log (KT^2 )}{G_T} ) \sqrt{\frac{\lambda}{\kappa_\mu w}}+ 2\varepsilon'_{w,T} = \tilde{O} ( \sqrt{\frac{\tilde{d}}{T}} )$.

results.notes: Same as UCB variant with an extra log(K T^2) factor hidden in O_tilde. Worst-over-contexts gap mapped to simple_regret.
